title: Your First Abnormality
description:
Unleash your first Abnormality from the Containment Unit by interacting with its block.

The Containment Unit block is critical for tethering your Abnormality to this plane of existence.

Every day you will need to do one of the following things:
- MAINTENANCE - Repair the Containment Unit
- RESEARCH - Observe behaviors of the abnormality, learning more about it
- WORK - Extract Enkephalin from the Abnormality

Failure to do any of these things my have financial and/or security related consequences.
